theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoWeighted.braidTrace_eq_kz {m : ℕ} (c κ : ℂ) (hκ : SchurWeyl.GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)) (w : Fin 2 → ℂ) (wi : ℂ) (β : IwahoriHecke.BraidGroup.BraidGroupN m) :
IwahoriHecke.BraidGroup.braidTrace (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ ⋯ w wi β = wi ^ (m + 1) * (IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * (KohnoAssembly.kzHeckeC m c κ) ((SchurWeyl.JimboActionKernel.skeinCoxAEquiv (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) ⋯ m).symm ↑((IwahoriHecke.BraidGroup.heckeRep (IwahoriHecke.TensorEmbed.coxA m) ⋯ ⋯) β))).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoWeighted.siteWeight_trace_kz_eq_jimbo {m : ℕ} (c κ : ℂ) (hκ : SchurWeyl.GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)) (w : Fin 2 → ℂ) (x : SchurWeyl.Hecke ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ m) :
(IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * (KohnoAssembly.kzHeckeC m c κ) x).trace = (IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * (KohnoAssembly.jimboRep (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) ⋯ m) x).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoWeighted.siteWeight_eq_diag_cnt {N : ℕ} (w : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w = Matrix.diagonal fun (a : Fin N → Fin 2) => (fun (k : ℕ) => w 0 ^ (N - k) * w 1 ^ k) (cnt a)

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoWeighted.prod_weight_eq {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (w : Fin 2 → R) {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → Fin 2) :
∏ s : Fin N, w (a s) = w 0 ^ (N - cnt a) * w 1 ^ cnt a

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoWeighted.weighted_trace_kz_eq_jimbo {m : ℕ} (c κ : ℂ) (hκ : SchurWeyl.GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (x : SchurWeyl.Hecke ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ m) :
((Matrix.diagonal fun (a : Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) => f (cnt a)) * (KohnoAssembly.kzHeckeC m c κ) x).trace = ((Matrix.diagonal fun (a : Fin (m + 1) → Fin 2) => f (cnt a)) * (KohnoAssembly.jimboRep (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) ⋯ m) x).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoWeighted.trace_res_kz_eq_jimbo {m : ℕ} (c κ : ℂ) (hκ : SchurWeyl.GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)) (k : ℕ) (x : SchurWeyl.Hecke ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ m) :
(res k ((KohnoAssembly.kzHeckeC m c κ) x)).trace = (res k ((KohnoAssembly.jimboRep (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) ⋯ m) x)).trace

theorem QOU.Mass.KohnoWeighted.conj_of_eq_at_zero {n : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] (ρ ρ' : (κ : ℂ) → SchurWeyl.Hecke ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ n →ₐ[ℂ] Matrix M M ℂ) (hρ : ∀ (j : Fin n), Continuous fun (κ : ℂ) => (ρ κ) (SchurWeyl.Hecke.σ ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ n j)) (hρ' : ∀ (j : Fin n), Continuous fun (κ : ℂ) => (ρ' κ) (SchurWeyl.Hecke.σ ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ n j)) (h0 : ∀ (j : Fin n), (ρ 0) (SchurWeyl.Hecke.σ ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC 0) (KohnoAssembly.qC 0)⁻¹ n j) = (ρ' 0) (SchurWeyl.Hecke.σ ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC 0) (KohnoAssembly.qC 0)⁻¹ n j)) {κ : ℂ} (hκ : SchurWeyl.GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)) :
∃ (U : (Matrix M M ℂ)ˣ), ∀ (h : SchurWeyl.Hecke ℂ (KohnoAssembly.qC κ) (KohnoAssembly.qC κ)⁻¹ n), ↑U * (ρ κ) h = (ρ' κ) h * ↑U
